notes: Fake helpdesk agent with no link at all: asks the target to type their password into chat for a 'VPN migration'. No capture page, so rule 1 does not apply; rule 2 (pretends to be internal IT) -> T1656. Tests the rule 1 vs rule 2 boundary.

It's an emergency change so it won't show yet. I just need to re-sync your account. Can you type your current password here and I'll push the profile?
haha you know I can't do that. what's your extension? I'll ping you on Teams
Teams is down for the migration. Call me on +1 (646) 555-0133 or email itsupport@acme-helpdesk.example. Directors approved this change, so please cooperate.
sure, give me a sec, three P2s just landed in my queue
The window closes at 6pm. If your profile isn't synced by then you'll be locked out of VPN tomorrow morning.
